label: PHASE_N_ARCHITECTURE_DECISION_V1
rationale: Phase L shows domain adaptation is viable: fine-tuned YOLOv8n achieves 9× improvement in IoU50 recall over frozen COCO weights on DEVELOPMENT val dives. Given viable detection, the architecture should be: (1) fine-tuned YOLOv8n per-frame detector (L1 config), (2) ByteTrack for lightweight inter-frame consistency. SAM2 video mask tracking is explicitly rejected: J1/J2 show IMMEDIATE_COLLAPSE at 360p for both tiny and base_plus — model size does not overcome the resolution limit. PER_FRAME_DETECTION_SUFFICIENT is rejected: frozen F1 recall=8.3% is insufficient even with fine-tuning alone. PERCEPTION_STILL_INSUFFICIENT is superseded: domain adaptation demonstrated viable.

rejected_options.PER_FRAME_DETECTION_SUFFICIENT: Frozen F1 only 8.3% IoU50; fine-tuned model still benefits from temporal consistency
rejected_options.VIDEO_MASK_TRACKING_JUSTIFIED: SAM2 collapses at 360p for 5/6 tiny dives, same for base_plus
rejected_options.PERCEPTION_STILL_INSUFFICIENT: Superseded by Phase L VIABLE result

next_steps: Train final L1 model on full 38 DEVELOPMENT frames (no val split, max training data)
Integrate with ByteTrack in proposer_baseline_cc3 or equivalent
Evaluate on INTERNAL_EVAL with V2 PTS ground truth
Target: >=50% within-tolerance rate to clear production bar
caveat: 360p proxy scale remains the fundamental constraint. Detection recall on unseen pools/cameras unknown. Original resolution processing would substantially improve all metrics.
